title: Pod Salt Nexus Mr Blue Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Pod Salt Nexus Mr Blue Nic Salt is a layered medley of dark and bright berries. Blackberry provides a deep, slightly tart foundation, while Blueberry adds smooth sweetness and Raspberry contributes a sharper edge. Together, these three fruits create a vibrant berry blend that tastes full-bodied and rounded from start to finish. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with refillable vape kits , vape pens , and vape starter devices . The nicotine salt formulation delivers rapid absorption with a tactile yet comfortable throat hit, offering consistent flavour and discreet vapour production. Part of the Pod Salt Nexus range, Mr Blue highlights the collection’s ability to balance fruit profiles with both clarity and depth. Every 10ml bottle is crafted with premium-quality ingredients, ensuring reliable flavour and smooth performance.
